UserAccountProfile.title: UserAccountProfile
UserAccountProfile.description: User account profile and server-controlled credit and subscription ledger.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

preferredDetailLevel.description: Default study PDF detail level preference.

bonusCreditsRemaining.description: One-time welcome bonus credits remaining (initialized to 3, server-controlled).

dailyFreeCredits.description: Daily free generation credits remaining (initialized to 1, server-controlled).

lastDailyResetEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day of last daily credit reset.

rewardedAdCreditsToday.description: Extra generation credits earned from verified rewarded ads today (server-controlled).

rewardedAdsWatchedToday.description: Count of verified rewarded ads completed today (server-controlled).

StudyJob.title: StudyJob
StudyJob.description: Video-to-Study-PDF processing job record and status tracker.

sourceUri.description: YouTube URL or local file URI identifier.

videoTitle.description: Resolved title of the educational video.

videoDurationSeconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

currentStageDetail.description: Human-readable description of the active processing step.

creditDeducted.description: Whether a generation credit was reserved/deducted for this job.

creditRefunded.description: Whether the reserved credit was refunded due to a qualifying failure.

errorMessage.description: Optional diagnostic message when status is FAILED or CANCELLED.

localPdfPath.description: Optional path to the generated PDF document on device.

contentHash.description: Deterministic hash of source + detail level for caching.

MonetizationVerificationEvent.title: MonetizationVerificationEvent
MonetizationVerificationEvent.description: Append-only idempotent verification record for rewarded ad SSV, Play Billing purchases, and credit reservations.

eventType.description: Type of monetization or credit verification event.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique idempotency key matching document ID.

referenceId.description: Ad unit ID, Play subscription product ID, or StudyJob ID.

verificationPayload.description: Opaque verification token, SSV nonce, or purchase token.

verificationStatus.description: Initial status submitted by client for backend verification.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user account profile and server-guarded credit ledger.

/study_jobs/{jobId}.description: Root collection of video-to-PDF processing jobs isolated by userId.

/monetization_events/{eventId}.description: Append-only idempotent verification ledger for ads, subscriptions, and credits.
